company.name: Aster DM Healthcare
company.shortDescription: Headquartered in Dubai, the journey towards excellence in Healthcare was started by Dr. Azad Moopen, a doctor turned entrepreneur.
company.description: Aster is the new name spearheading a vital vertical of DM Healthcare. It is a corollary of expansion integrating the current brands of clinics, polyclinics, pharmacies and diagnostic centres at 95 locations under one name. Aster interfaces with existing and new customers through Aster Hospital, Aster Medical Centre, Aster Pharmacy and Aster Diagnostic Centre.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,399,630,444 to $2,034,441,131, a 1.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 64 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
